:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}
#### Log-likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Write the log-likelihood of $\vy$
from @exr-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}

Starting from the likelihood in @sol-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell(\pi; \vy)
&= \logf{\pi^{\sumin y_i} (1 - \pi)^{n - \sumin y_i}}
&& \text{(log of the likelihood)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin y_i} \logf{\pi} + \paren{n - \sumin y_i} \logf{1 - \pi}
&& \text{(log of a product; log of a power)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin y_i} \paren{\logf{\pi} - \logf{1 - \pi}} + n \logf{1 - \pi}
&& \text{(collect the terms in $\textstyle\sumin y_i$)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin y_i} \logf{\frac{\pi}{1 - \pi}} + n \logf{1 - \pi}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin y_i} \logit(\pi) + n \logf{1 - \pi}
&& \text{(definition of $\logit$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
